name: Terrain Minerals Limited
summary: Terrain Minerals Limited engages in the exploration of gold, base and energy metals, and other mineral resources in Australia. The company owns a 100% interests in the Wild Viper Gold Exploration Project located in the Goldfields Highway. It also holds interests in the Smokebush Gold Exploration Project located in the Paynes Find within the Yalgoo Mineral Field. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in West Perth, Australia.
